t: The original STM32 chip, best known from the very cheap Blue Pill board.
steps: Buy an ST NUCLEO-F103RB from the ST eStore, DigiKey or Mouser for about 32 US dollars. It has a built-in debugger.
Install the free Arduino IDE on your computer.
Add the STM32duino board package in the Boards Manager.
Plug in the Nucleo with a USB cable and pick it from the board list.
Upload the Blink example and watch the LED flash.
Try a Blue Pill next with an ST-Link programmer on its SWD pins.
Check the USB resistor on a Blue Pill. Many need a 1.5k part to show up over USB.
Move to ST's free CubeIDE or open GCC tools for deeper C work.
meta: Wild Open. From $31.25. A few stores.
